name: UI
summary: Screens and overlays: main menu, lobby, race settings, the in-race HUD, and controller-friendly widgets (Stepper), and the pit wall (StrategistScreen: timing, gaps, pit windows, weather radar like a real rain radar over a map with range rings, cell movement, a past-and-forecast loop and the coming changes (WeatherRadar), team radio feed). Co-op pit wall roles (CrewConsole: pit crew and strategist panels around the zoomed-out 3D race, combined for 2 players) and quick team radio calls (TeamRadio). Intro screen (SplashScreen: key art and a GT3 pass-by), the main menu over a loop of race highlights (MenuBackground), the player's profile badge top right (ProfileBadge), and the driver's own HUD layout (HudLayout, saved in GameData.prefs["hud_layout"]) with a minimal co-op driver layout (GameData.prefs["hud_layout_coop"]) and its editor (HudEditor: move, resize, hide items with mouse and keyboard; F2 in a race or Settings > Gameplay over a preview race), and the driver's pit call menu (PitCallMenu: tyres, which tyres, wings, fuel, repairs when calling a stop in single player) and the pit lane guide cues on the HUD, the in-race pause menu (PauseMenu: Esc / Start; resume, restart, settings with race and car settings locked, quit to menu or desktop; an overlay online, host-only restart), the end of a race (SpectatorHud: once your car is home, watch the rest of the race from any car and camera view; RaceResults: the results screen faded in when every car has finished, with best laps, average laps, best sectors, best potential laps, penalties, points and the championship, from ResultsTable), and Settings (SettingsScreen: Gameplay, Controller with rebindable keys and buttons, Graphics, Sound, Garage, Debug, built from GameData.settings_catalog; SettingsRuntime applies them).
notes: Main menu scene: main_menu.tscn. The single race page and the host lobby remember their last race settings per race type (GameData.prefs["race_memory"]; check: tests/race_memory_check.tscn). SetupScreen: the controller-friendly car setup screen; SetupStore saves setups per car per track in user://setups/. First scene: splash.tscn, which goes on to main_menu.tscn. Menu media in media/ (splash.jpg, highlights.ogv; tools/record_highlights.sh films the highlights). PitPlanner: the strategist's pit stop planner (plan view of the car, per-tyre compound and pressure, front/rear downforce, fuel, repairs, driver change, box call; queued, then Send gives the crew the plan and radios it to the driver as a code pit_plan message with lines). CrewConsole, StrategistScreen and TeamRadio take mouse and keyboard first. The panels on CrewConsole and StrategistScreen move, zoom and resize by dragging (PanelLayout: title bar moves, bottom right grip zooms the panel with its text, 60-200 %, right and bottom edges resize, snapping to edges and each other), saved in GameData.prefs["pit_wall_layout"] per screen; Reset layout in the header puts them back.
